shortDescription: Handle key management operations in a tang server.

options.name: keydir
options.description: key database directory on the Tang server "/var/db/tang"

options.name: keys_to_deploy_dir
options.description: deploys keys that are present in keys_to_deploy_dir

options.name: state
options.description:
indicates the state to achieve, which basically maps to
certain operations to be performed.
If no state is specified, no action is performed.
 keys-rotated:
this performs a key rotation followed by the creation of new
keys. Required parameters are keygen and keydir, that point
to the tang key generation tool and the tang key directory.
Optional arguments are update and cachedir.  When these
arguments are provided, the cache is updated when there are changes.
 keys-created:
creates a new set of k

options.name: update
options.description: the tool for performing a cache update "/usr/libexec/tangd-update"
